title.en: Gemini API Key: Get a Google AI Studio Key (2026)
title.zh: Gemini API Key 获取指南：Google AI Studio 官方入口（2026）

excerpt.en: Create and manage a Gemini API key in Google AI Studio, understand the current free and paid tiers, migrate to Auth keys, and test a secure first request.
excerpt.zh: 通过 Google AI Studio 创建并管理 Gemini API Key，了解当前免费与付费层级、Auth key 迁移要求，并安全完成第一次请求。

heading.zh: Gemini API Key 官方入口

en: Create and manage your key on the official Google AI Studio API Keys page: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey. A new user who accepts the terms gets a default Google Cloud project and API key automatically; you can also create another key and associate it with a project.

Google calls newly created AI Studio keys Auth keys. They are restricted to the Gemini API by default and include leaked-key enforcement. Do not paste a key into public source code or browser-side JavaScript.
zh: 请在 Google AI Studio 官方 API Keys 页面创建和管理密钥：https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey。新用户接受条款后，系统会自动创建默认 Google Cloud 项目和 API Key；你也可以创建新 Key 并关联项目。
Google 将 AI Studio 当前新建的密钥称为 Auth key。它默认仅用于 Gemini API，并带有泄漏密钥阻断机制。不要把 Key 写进公开代码仓库或浏览器端 JavaScript。

en: Sign in to Google AI Studio
Copy the Auth key and store it as GEMINI_API_KEY
zh: 接受 Gemini API 条款
打开 API Keys 页面
复制 Auth key，并保存为 GEMINI_API_KEY 环境变量

heading.en: Important: migrate Standard keys before September 2026
heading.zh: 重要：在 2026 年 9 月前迁移 Standard key

en: Google states that the Gemini API will reject Standard keys in September 2026. New AI Studio keys are already Auth keys. If an older integration uses a Standard key, open AI Studio and migrate it before the deadline to prevent service interruption.
A Standard key with explicit API restrictions can continue to work under Google's current transition rules, but the safest documented route is to migrate to an Auth key in AI Studio.
zh: Google 官方说明，Gemini API 将在 2026 年 9 月拒绝 Standard key。AI Studio 当前新建的 Key 已默认是 Auth key。如果旧项目仍使用 Standard key，应在截止日期前到 AI Studio 完成迁移，避免服务中断。
在当前过渡规则下，显式配置了 API 限制的 Standard key 仍可工作；但官方推荐且更稳妥的方式，是在 AI Studio 中迁移为 Auth key。

heading.en: What the Gemini free tier actually includes
heading.zh: Gemini 免费层实际包含什么

en: New accounts begin on the Free Tier. It provides free input and output for selected Gemini models, subject to the active limits shown for your project in AI Studio. Google does not promise one universal RPM or daily quota: limits depend on the model, project tier, account status, and available capacity.

The Paid Tier requires linking billing. Google's current billing guide says some accounts must prepay at least $10. Paid usage provides higher limits, access to additional models and features, and different data-use terms. Since March 2026, Gemini API usage is excluded from the $300 Google Cloud Free Trial credit.
Rate limits apply per project, not per API key. Check the live RPM, TPM, and RPD values in AI Studio before deployment.
zh: 新账户从免费层开始。部分 Gemini 模型的输入和输出可在免费层内免费使用，但必须遵守 AI Studio 中该项目显示的实时限额。Google 并未承诺统一的 RPM 或每日请求数；限额会随模型、项目层级、账户状态和可用容量变化。
升级付费层需要关联结算账户。Google 当前结算文档说明，部分账户需要至少预付 10 美元。付费层具有更高限额、更多模型和功能，并采用不同的数据使用条款。自 2026 年 3 月起，Gemini API 用量不再适用 Google Cloud 300 美元免费试用金。
限额按项目计算，而不是按单个 API Key 计算。上线前应在 AI Studio 查看实时 RPM、TPM 与 RPD。

heading.en: Test the key with the current Google Gen AI SDK
heading.zh: 使用当前 Google Gen AI SDK 测试 Key

en: Install Google's current SDK, keep the secret in an environment variable, and make a small request before adding application logic. Replace the model ID only with one shown as available in your AI Studio project.
zh: 安装 Google 当前 SDK，把密钥放在环境变量中，并先发送最小请求，再接入业务逻辑。模型 ID 应以你的 AI Studio 项目实际可用列表为准。

codeBlocks.code:
from google import genai
import os

client = genai.Client(api_key=os.environ["GEMINI_API_KEY"])
response = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-3.5-flash",
    contents="Reply with exactly: KEY_WORKS",
)
print(response.text)

caption.zh: 服务端 Python Key 检查

codeBlocks.code:
curl "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-3.5-flash:generateContent" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -X POST \
  -d '{"contents":[{"parts":[{"text":"Reply with exactly: KEY_WORKS"}]}]}'

heading.zh: 常见 Key 与配额错误

en: A 400 response usually indicates an invalid request or unavailable model ID. A 403 can indicate a key, project, terms, API restriction, or supported-region problem. A 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED response means a rate or spend limit was reached; wait and retry with backoff, reduce request size, or inspect the project's current limits in AI Studio.
Google says failed 400 and 500 requests are not billed for tokens, although they can still count against quota.
zh: 400 通常表示请求格式错误或模型 ID 不可用；403 可能与 Key、项目、条款、API 限制或支持地区有关；429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED 表示触发速率或消费限制，应等待并指数退避重试、缩小请求，或在 AI Studio 检查项目实时限额。
Google 说明，失败的 400 和 500 请求不会收取 Token 费用，但仍可能计入配额。

en: For a screen-by-screen AI Studio walkthrough, use [[guide:how-to-get-gemini-api-key|the step-by-step key tutorial]]. For key and project management, use [[guide:google-ai-studio-api-key|the Google AI Studio guide]]. For a code-first path, use [[guide:gemini-api-key-quickstart-2026|the Gemini API quickstart]]. For model prices, see [[guide:google-gemini-api-pricing|the current Gemini model pricing guide]].
zh: 需要逐屏操作说明，请阅读[[guide:how-to-get-gemini-api-key|获取 Key 分步教程]]；需要管理 Key 与项目，请阅读[[guide:google-ai-studio-api-key|Google AI Studio 指南]]；希望直接运行代码，请阅读[[guide:gemini-api-key-quickstart-2026|Gemini API 快速入门]]；模型价格请查看[[guide:google-gemini-api-pricing|当前 Gemini 模型定价指南]]。

question.en: What is the official Gemini API key URL?
question.zh: Gemini API Key 的官方网址是什么？

answer.en: Use https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey. This is Google AI Studio's official key-management page.
answer.zh: 请使用 https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey，这是 Google AI Studio 官方密钥管理页面。

question.en: Is a Gemini API key free?

answer.en: Creating a key is free. Selected models have a Free Tier with project-specific limits; paid usage requires billing.
answer.zh: 创建 Key 本身免费。部分模型提供带项目限额的免费层；付费用量需要开通结算。

question.en: Do I need a credit card for the Free Tier?
question.zh: 使用免费层需要信用卡吗？

answer.en: Google describes new accounts as starting on the Free Tier. Billing and a payment method are needed only when upgrading to a Paid Tier.
answer.zh: Google 说明新账户默认从免费层开始；升级付费层时才需要设置结算与支付方式。

question.en: Are Gemini limits shared across API keys?
question.zh: 多个 Gemini API Key 是否共享限额？

answer.en: Limits are applied per Google Cloud project, not per API key.
answer.zh: 限额按 Google Cloud 项目计算，而不是按单个 API Key 计算。

title.en: Gemini API Key: Get a Free Google AI Studio Key (2026)
title.zh: Gemini API Key 获取：Google AI Studio 免费层与教程（2026）

description.en: Create a Gemini API key at aistudio.google.com/app/apikey. Check the Free Tier, migrate to Auth keys, secure the key, and test your first request.
description.zh: 在 aistudio.google.com/app/apikey 创建 Gemini API Key，了解免费层、Auth key 迁移、安全配置并完成首次请求。
